The '''Voidgloom Seraph''' (/ˈsɛrəf/, "the burning one"; plural '''Seraphim''' /ˈsɛrəfɪm/)<ref>https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seraph</ref> is a [[Slayer]] [[Boss]] in the [[Enderman Slayer]] branch. It is an Enderman with strong attacks. It is significantly stronger than the previous Slayer bosses. 

Defeating the {{Stier|3}} Voidgloom Seraph results in unlocking the [[Blaze Slayer]] quest and the [[Inferno Demonlord]] boss.

== Behavior ==
The '''Voidgloom Seraph''' is an Enderman-type mob hostile to all players. It has the appearance of an enderman with critical particles following it. It has a smaller aggro range compared to other Slayers.

[[Aspect of the Dragons]] and [[Ice Spray Wand]] don't affect Voidgloom Seraph. They are immune to water damage.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HnvfMx-xfx0&t=99</ref> Like normal Endermen, they are also immune to the damage from most arrows, except those shot using a [[Juju Shortbow]] or [[Terminator]]. However, regardless of the bow type, they can all apply 1 hit per arrow.

When the Voidgloom Seraphim's Hitshield is not active, {{Stat|Ferocity}} that is effective on them is divided by 4.

As with all Slayer bosses, if the Voidgloom Seraph has not dealt damage to a player for some time, it will begin rapidly regenerating {{Stat|hp}}. The regeneration immediately stops when it hits a player again. If 4 minutes pass without the boss being defeated, it will despawn, failing the Slayer quest. A timer is shown above its head indicating the remaining time.

[[Voidling Fanatic]] and [[Voidling Extremist]] spawns are suppressed in the vicinity of a Voidgloom Seraph.

Each tier has all of the abilities from the ones before it.

=== {{SlayerTier|I}} ===

*'''Malevolent Hitshield''' appears upon spawning and reaching {{hp|200k}} (2/3) and {{hp|100k}} (1/3). The boss does not gain DPS while the shield is up. The shield has no invincibility frames. All types of arrows can remove 1 hit per shot from the shield. It has 15 hits. Purple particles surround the Seraph when its shield is up. When attacked in this state, it teleports into a block within a 1 block radius by up to 60 times per second. Upon the shield being destroyed, the boss resumes attacking as normal. 
*'''Dissonance''' begin when the boss is alive. The boss teleports behind or next to the player who spawned it, which happens more often if the player doesn't move. It deals 40% of its DPS to all players fighting it in a 6.5 block radius. However, in and only in Tier I bosses, the AOE damage doesn't apply. The teleportation, however, remains usable for all tiers of bosses.

=== {{SlayerTier|II}} ===

*'''Malevolent Hitshield''' appears upon spawning and reaching {{hp|8M}} (2/3) and {{hp|4M}} (1/3). It has 30 hits. The boss gains +2,000 DPS every 3s the shield is up; this bonus DPS is removed once the shield is destroyed.

*'''Yang Glyphs''' appear upon reaching {{hp|6M}} (1/2). 
**The Seraph will begin to hold Yang Glyphs, which appear as a beacon. After 2 seconds, it will throw the glyph to a nearby spot. Any player fighting the Seraph can destroy the glyph by standing adjacent to or on top of it. If it is not destroyed within 5 seconds, it deals {{Red|1000 × Max}} {{Stat|hp}} in {{Stat|tdmg}} to all players fighting the Seraph. The abilities of the [[Mithril Coat]] and [[Wither Cloak Sword]] can block this damage. Glyphs cannot be thrown when the Hitshield is up. The Seraph will continue to try to throw Glyphs until it is defeated.

=== {{SlayerTier|III}} ===

*'''Malevolent Hitshield''' appears upon spawning and reaching {{hp|33,333,333}} (2/3) and {{hp|16,666,666}} (1/3). It has 60 hits. The boss gains +2,000 DPS every 3s the shield is up; this bonus DPS is removed once the shield is destroyed.

*'''Yang Glyphs''' begin at {{hp|33,333,333}} (2/3) and are thrown more often.

*'''Nukekubi Fixation''' heads spawn around the player it is attacking upon reaching {{hp|16,666,666}} (1/3). The heads can be destroyed by looking directly at them for 0.5s. They can be destroyed through walls. When they are destroyed, they will play a hissing sound. Each head attacks with a faint blue laser, and increases the Dissonance damage by 600 per second, which is doubled for each head alive. If the heads' damage is more than the boss's base damage, the boss's damage is nullified and only heads deal damage.

*'''Broken Heart Radiation''' occurs at {{hp|175M}} (5/6), {{hp|105M}} (1/2) and {{hp|35M}} (1/6).
**The Seraph stops moving for 8 seconds, taking the appearance of being seated. Explosion particles appear centered on the Seraph when this starts.
**After 2 seconds, it becomes invulnerable and casts 12 Broken Heart Radiation beams over the next 6 seconds: 4 groups of 3 20-block long beams, stacked 1 block on top of each other, each group at 90° to each other. The beams pass through walls. The beams spawn pointing in the cardinal directions, and rotate clockwise for the duration, completing slightly less than three quarters of a full rotation in the 6 seconds. They begin blue and change to purple, then green over the duration. In Minecraft 1.16 and beyond, bubble particles are added.
**Any player fighting the Seraph who comes into contact with a beam takes 800 {{stat|true_dmg}} and has {{stat|vitality|-12}} for 90s. The {{stat|vitality}} reduction stacks. In addition, any player fighting the Seraph who steps out of reach of the beams begins to take 10% of their max health as {{stat|true_dmg}} twice per second. 
**Yang Glyphs and Nukekubi Fixations can be thrown in this phase. However, Dissonance for the Voidgloom Seraph deals 0 damage during Broken Heart Radiation.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Voidgloom Seraph''' {{Stier|4}} used to have {{stat|hp|300M}}, one of the highest {{Stat|hp}} of all non-dungeon enemies in the game.
*'''Nukekubi Fixation''' heads can be thrown through walls, though Players can still destroy the heads by looking at them.
*Thrown '''Yang Glyphs''' can sometimes replace blocks such as stairs, {{Item|End Stone}} and glass panes. When the '''Glyph''' is destroyed, the block will not be replaced until the server restarts.
*When using '''Broken Heart Radiation''', the particles from the '''Voidgloom Seraph''' teleporting to the player will sometimes show. The Seraph will not move.
*The '''Voidgloom Seraph'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s invulnerability during '''Broken Heart Radiation''' does not start until the lasers are fired, leaving a brief period of vulnerability in the transition phase.
*If a '''Voidgloom Seraph''' {{stier|4}} despawns while attacking with '''Broken Heart Radiation''', the beams will persist indefinitely. These beams are visual only.
*The '''Voidgloom Seraph'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s name may be a reference to [[w:Seraph of the End|''Seraph of the End'']].
*The name of '''Nukekubi Fixations''' are a reference to [http://yokai.com/nukekubi nukekubi], a mythical creature in Japanese folklore whose head detaches from its body.
*When in the '''Malvolent Hitshield''', the '''Voidgloom Seraph''' can take damage using bows other than the {{Item|Juju Shortbow}} and {{Item|Terminator}}, making it easy to quickly defeat the shield.
*The '''Voidgloom Seraph''' does not take damage from water, but attacks less when in water.
*If a player deals enough damage to a {{stier|4}} '''Voidgloom Seraph''' just as '''Broken Heart Radiation''' triggers to also trigger '''Malevolent Hitshield''', the boss will not throw '''Yang Glyphs''' during this phase and immediately start in the Hitshields phase after the lasers complete their full rotation.
* Voidgloom Seraph and the [[Riftstalker Bloodfiend]] are the only two Slayer boss that can be spawned in one type of island, which are {{zone|the end}} and {{Zone|Stillgore Château}} respectively.
*It is possible to grief others' if one hits the Voidgloom Seraph only a couple times by using a invincibility item that blocks {{stat|true_dmg}} instead of breaking it yourself.
